stories.title: Consent Audit Persistence and Retrieval
stories.description: Implement persistence of consent decisions, tier changes, and data handling actions (store, de-identify, reject) with retrieval capability for audit and compliance review.

stories.title: Consent Core Logic Hardening for De-identification and Summarization
stories.description: Enhance consent_service to enforce deterministic de-identification (HIPAA Safe Harbor) and consistent conversation summarization before storage, including edge case handling and failure fallbacks.

stories.title: Lead Service Integration with Consent Tier Enforcement
stories.description: Integrate consent enforcement into lead_service to ensure Tier 2 consent is required for identifiable lead storage and that Tier 1 flows enforce de-identified capture only.

stories.title: Consent Status Query API for Downstream Consumers
stories.description: Expose API endpoint to retrieve current consent tier and storage eligibility status for a session/user to support enforcement across services like safety, unknowns, and lead capture.
